explanation: F(3) = 7, as stated in the paper per the docstring, with a linked Lean proof. A 7-vertex triangle-free 3-chromatic graph with f = 3 exists and none smaller. Source: Erdős–Fajtlowicz–Staton, 'Degree sequences in triangle-free graphs', Discrete Math. 92 (1991) 85–88. The full text was not accessible; the zbMATH review summary says that triangle-free graphs in which no degree occurs more than twice are bipartite, and that every triangle-free graph is an induced subgraph of one in which no degree occurs more than three times. It is not independently verified here; the linked proof supports it.
